def dif_Square(n: int) -> bool:
    """Return True if n can be represented as the difference of two perfect squares."""
    # Numbers congruent to 2 mod 4 cannot be expressed as x^2 - y^2
    return n % 4 != 2

# Example assertions
assert dif_Square(5) == True   # 5 = 3^2 - 2^2
assert dif_Square(8) == True   # 8 = 3^2 - 1^2 (9 - 1)
assert dif_Square(6) == False  # 6 ≡ 2 mod 4 → impossible

# Additional checks for completeness
for i in range(-5, 10):
    assert dif_Square(i) is True or dif_Square(i) is False  # just to ensure no exceptions
